scopeBasis: Provided chapter plan, textbook sections and teacher deck. The original course scope is preserved through the listed lessons.
officialCodeStatus: Not independently verified against a retrievable current official outcome register. No outcome codes have been invented. Confirm code-level mapping during division/Codex acceptance.

lessons.title: Evidence that DNA carries genetic information
lessons.learningGoal: Connect each experiment with its observation, control and justified conclusion.

lessons.title: DNA structure and complementary strands
lessons.learningGoal: Identify nucleotide components, complementary base pairing and antiparallel strand directions.

lessons.title: DNA replication and its products
lessons.learningGoal: Trace semiconservative replication using base pairing, enzyme roles and the 5′ to 3′ synthesis rule.

lessons.title: Genes, RNA and the flow of information
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish DNA storage from RNA and protein roles, and explain selective gene expression.

lessons.title: Transcription and RNA processing
lessons.learningGoal: Use template and coding strand identities to construct mRNA and explain eukaryotic RNA processing.

lessons.title: Translation and the genetic code
lessons.learningGoal: Use mRNA codons, tRNA anticodons and start/stop signals to explain polypeptide synthesis.

lessons.title: Solving DNA, RNA and protein problems
lessons.learningGoal: Solve sequence problems by identifying the supplied molecule, direction, frame and requested output.

lessons.title: Mutations and their effects on proteins
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish a DNA mutation from expression errors and explain substitution, frameshift and inheritance consequences.

lessons.title: Recombination and sources of variation
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish mutation, recombination and transfer of existing genetic material.

lessons.title: Recombinant DNA and genetic engineering
lessons.learningGoal: Explain the conceptual roles of restriction enzymes, ligase, vectors and expression in recombinant-DNA technology.

lessons.title: PCR, gels and interpreting DNA profiles
lessons.learningGoal: Explain DNA amplification and fragment separation, then interpret profiles within their limits.

lessons.title: Genetic technologies and evidence-based decisions
lessons.learningGoal: Compare sequencing, cloning and gene-based interventions by their mechanism, evidence and limits.
